Throughout my career in film and television, I've had the privilege of working across different markets—Hong Kong, Hollywood, and mainland China. Each experience has taught me something valuable about storytelling, about connecting with audiences, and about the universal human experiences that transcend language and culture. Whether I'm playing an action hero, a dramatic role, or even voicing animated characters, my goal remains the same: to bring authenticity and depth to every performance.

Today, I want to encourage all of you to embrace your own unique paths. Don't let anyone tell you that you have to fit into a single box. Your diverse experiences and perspectives are your greatest strengths.

Thank you.
